easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
The amount of +1/+1 counters on Sekki plus the number of other Spirits you control is at least eight.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, targeting Sekki. Sekki will prevent the 1 damage that would be dealt to it and instead removes a +1/+1 counter from it and creates a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirits enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat step 1, sacrificing the Frog, until Sekki dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sekki enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
